2: Coverage rescue across five representation methods

Gene counts reaching ≥70% represented variants (gray) and passing frozen disease balance eligibility (blue), among all 132 U2 genes. Representation requires ≥3 distinct credible valid partner features per variant. The five arms retain their distinct score meanings. Balanced counts are 3, 10, 3, 23 and 15 in the displayed order. 5: a, All ten frozen gene-level X-PAIR ΔR² values, with zero as reference. b, Paired labeled and sorted R² values on identical residue rows; connecting segments show within-gene comparisons. Raw sorting removes assignment to named partners and rank dimensions are separately standardized. No per-gene confidence interval was preregistered. c, Equal-weight median ΔR²=0.00179553 with existing 95% interval [−0.00410526, 0.00495717] from 10,000 gene bootstrap resamples, seed 20261005.
